title: pm-dispatch: retire the director seat's daily digest — the maintainer dropped the fleet daily report (2026-11-12)
body:
coordinator#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cw3hFWwj6wA2yQzyA2

The maintainer retired the fleet daily report on 2026-11-12 22:19Z (「车队日报 routine 作废，不需要」, then 「立卡处理」). The scheduled task that produced it (a project routine that rewrote one Claude Doc every day at 00:00Z) was disabled the same minute. The skill text still makes the director seat owe that digest, so a seat reading `pm-dispatch` would rebuild it. This card takes the duty out of the text.

## Do

Read on `origin/main` (2026-11-12 21:38Z):

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md`, section `## 职责四:每日摘要、发版板与总表`, first bullet `每日摘要:在飞/待裁/待落地/撞墙、复审逾 24h 的 PR、发版板、无卡 fork PR、外部需求行。` — remove the daily digest as a deliverable. Retitle the section so it no longer names `每日摘要`.
- The same section's external-demand rows (`外部需求行三数…` and its two follow-on bullets) are defined as part of the digest. Keep them only if another reading in the file still consumes them; otherwise remove them with the digest. Say in the PR which way you went and why.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md:67` — `五项健康指标进总监席的每日摘要` points at the retired digest. Drop that clause; keep the rest of the line.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md:58` — `正文由总监席日报与坐席/接管/移交重生成` names the digest as one regenerator of the roster issue. Drop `总监席日报与`.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` — lower the `lanes/director.md` ceiling (and any other touched file's) to the landed count, with a one-line note in the existing convention (lowering is always legitimate). The comment near line 1650 that mentions "the daily digest" is history; leave it.
- `git grep -n -i "日报\|每日摘要\|daily digest" -- .claude scripts/pm AGENTS.md` should return nothing that still assigns the duty.

## Out of scope

- The release board, the roster issue and the triage seat's daily reconciliation (`triage-duties.md` `每日一 fire…`, `每日看板`) stay; they are separate duties, not the retired report.
- No new duty replaces the digest.

## Done when

- No skill line under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` assigns a daily digest or daily report to any seat.
- The ratchet ceilings equal the landed counts; `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` passes.

class: b · type: Tooling · Suggested-grade: p2 · lane: `domain:skills` (skills seat 1 to dispatch).
